<!-- pr-reviewer: a91cc3bb770c1cd87606349ef6462b6c74bfcade -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Old and new page code diffed line by line: every control survives (units row, shape radios, models' size lines, Diameter/Height, Length/Width/Height, Source picker, raw-stock row, X/Y/Z, yaw, Per side, Fit margin(s), Apply, Fit to Models, Delete). Apply still queues `SetStock`, Fit queues `StockFit { margin, shape }` or `StockFitSides` under the same condition (box and Per side), Delete queues `DeleteByName` only while a stock exists, and the raw-stock tick still queues `SetRawStockOnly`. Defaults are unchanged. No direct field poke bypasses a command; the only state written is the page's own draft (`stock_ui`), as before.
- Layering holds: the new module only uses `camcraft_app::model/setup/stock` helpers and `state.pending`, no `sys_*` or world mutation.
- Matches #1440's pattern list (named groups, label-left grid, one `even_row` action row, progressive disclosure of size/source/per-side rows, quiet helper line). It reuses `layout::group`, `prop_grid` and `wcs_page::even_row`, with no private copies.
- No snapshot PNG changed. `stock_page.rs` is 194 lines with a provenance line; `pages.rs` shrank by 140 (still over 400, not blocking). Decision file present; no process files, deps, build.rs or scripts touched.
- The structural pin is mutation-red: I renamed the "Position and rotation" group and, separately, the "Fit to Models" button, and the test failed both times.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD crates/ui, single-threaded) | 675 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| ui suites `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `sinker_setup`, `theme_files` | 3 / 6 / 1 / 14 passed |
| `the_stock_page_is_laid_out_in_groups_like_the_wcs_page` | passed (red under both mutations) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -D warnings` | clean (a run without `--no-deps` stops on pre-existing camcraft-geometry lints, not this PR's) |
| camcraft-app suites | not run: the PR touches no app code; the quick-gate dry run lists post/app suites only because of the diff against current main |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Small behaviour difference: in `source_fields` (stock_page.rs, the `models.is_empty()` early `return`) the raw-stock row is no longer drawn when the document has no models. Before, `raw_stock_row` was called regardless, so its hint ("Apply a stock from a model...") and, for a stock already made from a model whose source was since deleted, the tick and the void note stayed reachable. Moving `super::raw_stock_row::raw_stock_row(ui, state);` above the early return restores that exactly.
2. The PR body still has the "(drag before.png here)" placeholders; per #1440 the maintainer wants the before/after screenshots seen before merging.
3. Not exercised here: hand look in the live window (headless only, as the author says).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a91cc3bb770c1cd87606349ef6462b6c74bfcade -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (one owed item: the before/after screenshots, below).

**What looks good**
- Layout-only move of the Stock page into `stock_page.rs` (194 lines; pages.rs shrinks by 143). Same commands (`SetStock`, `StockFit`, `StockFitSides`, `DeleteByName`, `SetRawStockOnly`), same labels, no project-file change; UI changes only go through the existing undoable commands, layering ui -> app is kept.
- New structural test `the_stock_page_is_laid_out_in_groups_like_the_wcs_page` (stock_size.rs) pins group order, field placement, one label column and equal-width actions; no snapshot PNG touched, no dependency, build.rs, .github, scripts or process-file change (no PROCESS_VERSION bump owed).
- Decision file `docs/decisions/1440-stock-page-tidy.md` present; `Refs #1440` (no closing keyword) is right for a one-of-five-pages PR.

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner `uma`: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43469392723, main at ecd112c, trial merge clean)
- Quick gate: ui suites ok (148 s), 0 failed
- Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- Windows-only readings: none in the diff, so nothing re-run locally.

**Owed before merge (maintainer, not a code blocker)**
1. UI law: the PR body still has the placeholder table `(drag before.png here)` / `(drag after.png here)`. Before/after screenshots are not attached; the author's comment says they will be added.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Not exercised: a hand-test in the live window (headless render only, per the PR body).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
